description: This file implements a multi-listener for TCP network connections, allowing listening on multiple addresses simultaneously and multiplexing incoming connections across them.

classes.name: multiListener
classes.description: A custom implementation of net.Listener that manages multiple sub-listeners and multiplexes incoming connections.

methods.name: MultiListen
methods.description: Creates a net.Listener that listens on multiple addresses using specified network type.

methods.name: multiListen
methods.description: Internal function that sets up multiple listeners and manages their lifecycle.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Waits for and returns an incoming connection from any of the sub-listeners.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes all sub-listeners and stops accepting new connections.

methods.name: Addr
methods.description: Returns the address of the first sub-listener.

methods.name: Addrs
methods.description: Returns the addresses of all sub-listeners.
